title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins will be able to define rules to automate agent lifecycle management.
description:
Admins will have the ability to set up rules for various scenarios, such as -

1. Auto block risky agents.
2. Auto delete inactive agents.
3. Auto reassign ownerless agents to manager. 

. #copilotcontrolsystem
